name: timeline
blurb: Vertical timeline connects entries with an animated gradient line as the user scrolls.
description: Displays timeline entries with titles and content. An animated gradient line traces from top to bottom as the container scrolls into view. Built with Framer Motion and scroll-triggered animation.
use_when: Chronological stories, journey narratives, or changelogs where visual progression matters.
avoid_when: Lists with 100+ items; all entries render upfront, causing performance issues.
a11y: Timeline entries render as divs within semantic structure. No explicit aria labels; depends on heading hierarchy for context.
